tasks.title: Software Engineering Assignment
tasks.description: CS305 team project: finish the room-booking API integration tests for authentication, overlapping reservations, and cancellation. Add the architecture diagram and individual contribution notes before uploading the repository link. Worth 25% of the module grade; two test cases and the final write-up remain.

tasks.title: Statistics Quiz
tasks.description: MA204 Quiz 3: revise conditional probability, binomial distributions, and confidence intervals. Work through the six practice questions and bring a calculator. The 20-minute LMS quiz opens Tuesday at 14:00 and closes at 17:00; it contributes 5% of the module grade.

tasks.title: Computer Graphics Lab
tasks.description: CS306 Lab 4: implement translation, rotation, and scaling for the sample scene. Compare flat and Gouraud shading, capture three screenshots, and explain the transformation order. The starter scene runs; finish the exercises and upload the code plus a short report.

tasks.title: Docker Practice
tasks.description: Run a FastAPI service and PostgreSQL container with Docker Compose. Use service-name DNS on a private network, confirm the API health check, and document reproducible setup and cleanup commands. Keep credentials in an untracked local environment file; the sample app already builds.

intelligence.title: Build a reproducible container workflow
intelligence.excerpt: Use a multi-stage Dockerfile, pin the base image, and add a health check to the room-booking API. Compare image size and startup behaviour, then record the commands in the project README.

intelligence.title: Take your first CI pipeline from test to release
intelligence.excerpt: Create a pull-request workflow that installs dependencies, runs integration tests, and builds a container only after the checks pass. Keep a failed-run screenshot and the corrected workflow as evidence.

intelligence.title: Troubleshoot service discovery in Docker Compose
intelligence.excerpt: Check service-name DNS, published ports, and readiness before blaming the API connection string. Work through a database connection failure and document which observation ruled out each possible cause.

intelligence.title: Explain least privilege with a small deployment example
intelligence.excerpt: Separate deployment permissions from runtime access. Write an example policy for reading one storage bucket and explain why a wildcard permission is unnecessary for the application.

intelligence.title: Follow a failed Linux service from status to logs
intelligence.excerpt: Use service status, journal logs, listening ports, and file permissions to diagnose a failed process. Keep a short troubleshooting timeline that another student can reproduce on a local VM.

intelligence.title: Make a project pull request easier to review
intelligence.excerpt: Split the API change into focused commits, describe the test cases, and link the issue. Review the diff for generated files and accidental secrets before asking a teammate for feedback.

notifications.title: Integration tests still need attention

notifications.description: Your 30-minute revision block is protected today. Review conditional probability and confidence intervals before opening the quiz.

notifications.title: Northstar Labs internship closes Oct 14
notifications.description: This sample role needs Git, Docker, and AWS fundamentals. Review the requirements and prepare your CV plus a reproducible project README.

notifications.title: Git release automation project is on your passport
notifications.description: The sample project includes reviewed pull requests, release tags, and a repeatable release script. Git evidence meets the internship requirement in this demo.
